new_elements: Component: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier array — Bank of transistor RF amplifiers that replaces the magnetron, with no cathode to wear and no warm-up delay.; Technology: Gallium nitride (GaN) RF power transistors — Wide-bandgap semiconductors that deliver hundreds of watts at 2.45 GHz with fine control of power and phase.; Function: Instant-on microwave generation — Full RF power is available within milliseconds of pressing start, so there is no magnetron warm-up.
